text_blocks.snippet: The Great Falls International Airport (GTF) has a ValuPark lot for long-term parking, with a daily maximum rate of $7. There is also a short-term lot with a daily maximum of $25. The ValuPark lot charges $2 for the first 60 minutes, then $1 for each additional 30 minutes, with the daily maximum of $7.
